hook.line: In a real discussion you rarely agree on everything. The skill is pinning down exactly where you agree, and where you stop.
hook.es: Coincido contigo en que hace falta más financiación.
hook.en: I agree with you that more funding is needed.

examples.es: Coincido contigo en que hace falta más financiación.
examples.en: I agree with you that more funding is needed.

examples.es: No coincido contigo en que sea la única opción.
examples.en: I don't agree with you that it's the only option.

examples.es: Estoy de acuerdo en todo, salvo en el plazo.
examples.en: I agree on everything except the deadline.

examples.es: Coincido contigo en lo de esperar.
examples.en: I agree with you about waiting.

examples.es: Coincido con Vale en que el café necesita ayuda.
examples.en: I agree with Vale that the café needs help.

examples.es: Mariana y Tomás coinciden en que hay que actuar.
examples.en: Mariana and Tomás agree that we have to act.

rule:
English says "agree that". Spanish *coincidir* always needs *en*: *coincido en que…*, never *coincido que*. Add the other person with *con*: *coincido contigo*, *coincido con Vale*.

After a plain *coincido en que*, use a normal verb: *hace falta*. When you say you do not agree, switch to the subjunctive: *no coincido en que sea…*

To narrow a disagreement, name the one point: *estoy de acuerdo en todo, salvo en…*
smallPrint: Teachers call this a verb with a fixed preposition: *coincidir* takes *en*, and a negated opinion takes the subjunctive.

readAndPick.es: Coincido contigo en que hace falta más financiación.
options: I disagree with you that more funding is needed.
I agree with you that more funding is needed.
You agree with me that more funding is needed.

readAndPick.es: No coincido contigo en que sea la única opción.
options: I don't agree with you that it's the only option.
I agree with you that it's the only option.
I agree with you that it isn't the only option.

readAndPick.es: Estoy de acuerdo en todo, salvo en el plazo.
options: I disagree on everything, including the deadline.
I agree only on the deadline.
I agree on everything except the deadline.

readAndPick.es: Coincido con Vale en que el café necesita ayuda.
options: Vale agrees with me that the café needs help.
I agree with Vale that the café needs help.
I disagree with Vale that the café needs help.
We disagree on almost everything.
We agree on everything.
We agree on almost everything.

readAndPick.es: ¿Coincides conmigo en que el precio es alto?
options: Do you agree with me that the price is high?
Do I agree with you that the price is high?
Don't you think the price is low?

readAndPick.es: Mariana y Tomás coinciden en que hay que actuar.
options: Mariana and Tomás disagree that we have to act.
Mariana and Tomás agree that we have to act.
Mariana agrees that Tomás has to act.

readAndPick.es: Ella no coincide con nosotros en que sea urgente.
options: She agrees with us that it's urgent.
We don't agree with her that it's urgent.
She doesn't agree with us that it's urgent.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *Coincido contigo ___ que hace falta más financiación.* (*en* or *de*) I agree with you that more funding is needed.
yourTurn.answer: Coincido contigo en que hace falta más financiación.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *Estoy de acuerdo en todo, ___ en el plazo.* (*salvo* or *pero*) I agree on everything except the deadline.
yourTurn.answer: Estoy de acuerdo en todo, salvo en el plazo.
accept: Estoy de acuerdo en todo, excepto en el plazo.
yourTurn.why: *Salvo en* marks the one thing you do not agree on.

yourTurn.prompt: Say to a friend: I agree with you about waiting.
yourTurn.answer: Coincido contigo en lo de esperar.
yourTurn.why: With a friend it is *contigo*, and *en* comes before the point.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: I agree with Vale that the café needs help.
yourTurn.answer: Coincido con Vale en que el café necesita ayuda.
yourTurn.why: *Con* plus a name, then *en que* and a normal verb.

yourTurn.prompt: Say you don't agree: *Coincido contigo en que es la única opción.* I don't agree with you that it's the only option.
yourTurn.answer: No coincido contigo en que sea la única opción.
yourTurn.why: After *no coincido en que*, the verb switches to *sea*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: We agree on almost everything.
Say it about Mariana and Tomás: *Coincido en que hay que actuar.* Mariana and Tomás agree that we have to act.
yourTurn.answer: Mariana y Tomás coinciden en que hay que actuar.
yourTurn.why: Two people means *coinciden*, and *en que* stays.

pitfalls.wrong: Coincido que hace falta más financiación.
pitfalls.right: Coincido en que hace falta más financiación.
pitfalls.why: English drops the little word, but Spanish keeps *en* every time.

pitfalls.wrong: No coincido contigo en que es la única opción.
pitfalls.right: No coincido contigo en que sea la única opción.
pitfalls.why: Once you say you don't agree, the verb after *en que* turns subjunctive: *sea*.

pitfalls.wrong: Coincido con ti en que hace falta más financiación.
pitfalls.right: Coincido contigo en que hace falta más financiación.

personal: Think of a friend you mostly agree with. Say what you agree on and the one thing you don't: *Coincido con… en…, salvo en…*
